This privacy policy (the “ Policy ”) describes how we use and protect personal data when you visit and interact with our website (the “ Site ”). Summary of the Policy Purpose of the Policy – This Policy applies to personal data related to Site visitors which Atriis processes as the data controller. Read more . Personal Data Collection – We share personal data with our service providers as necessary to facilitate our business and the Site. Read more . How Personal Data is Used – We use personal data to provide and maintain the Site, make it better, and protect us and the Site from misuse and law violations. Read more . Personal Data Sharing – We share information with our service providers as necessary to facilitate our business. We will share information when we change our corporate structure, and we will share the information with our affiliated entity. Read more . Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies – We use Google Analytics, to learn about how you and other users use the Site. Read more . Personal Data Retention – We retain different types of personal data for different periods, depending on the purposes for processing the information and legal requirements. Read more . Cross-Border Data Transfers – We store and process personal data in various locations as reasonably necessary for the proper performance of our Site. Read more . Communications – We or our business partners will contact you about our services. You may opt out of such communications. Read more . Personal Data Security – We implement physical, technical and organizational measures to secure personal data from loss, misuse, unauthorized access or disclosure, alteration or destruction. Read more . Specific provision for EEA residents – If we process personal data related to you when you are in the EEA, further terms apply to our processing in relation to your rights as a data subject under EEA data protection laws. Read more . Changes to this Privacy Policy – We will update this privacy policy from time to time after giving proper notice. Read more . Contact Us – In case of questions, please contact us at dpo@atriis.com or at our offices located at 14 Halamish St., 3079896 Caesarea, Israel. Read more . Purpose of the Policy This Policy describes how we process the personal data related to Site visitors ( “Visitors” ) who visit or interact with our Site, or prospective clients or partners to whom we send emails or communications (collectively, the “Communications” ). Throughout this Policy, Visitors will be addressed as “you” . You are not legally required to provide us with any personal data, and may do so (or avoid doing so) at your own free will and consent. If you do not wish to provide us with personal data related to you, or to have it processed by us, please avoid any interaction with us or any use of our Site. PERSONAL DATA COLLECTION When you visit our Site or contact us, we collect the following types of personal data : 1. Data You Provide Us: First and family name Mobile phone number Email address Company name Company website Job title Any other information you provide while communicating with us 2. Data Automatically Collected: IP address Device information (operating system, browser) Local and language settings Website usage data Technical data collected through cookies and similar technologies We collect such information by using “cookies” when your browser interacts with our Site. For further information about cookies, please see below under Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies. HOW PERSONAL DATA IS USED We process personal data for the following purposes : To operate and maintain our Site; To respond to inquiries about our services and demos; To facilitate and optimize our marketing and advertising campaigns; To support our data security measures; To comply with applicable laws and regulations; and Subject to your consent, to send you marketing communications. PERSONAL DATA SHARING Like many companies, we use a number of service providers to help us provide the Site. We disclose personal data to third party service providers to help us operate, manage and protect the Site. These service providers provide us with services such as hosting, analytics, enrichment, data and cyber security, and marketing automation (collectively, “Service Providers” ). We share personal data internally within our group, for the purposes described in this Policy. A merger, acquisition or any other structural change will require us to transfer personal data to another entity, as part of the structural change, provided that the receiving entity will not provide a lesser protection for personal data related to you than the level of protection under this Policy.
